title: ROUNDUP ( -1.1, 0 ) is -2: up means away from zero

source.quote: Rounds a number up, away from 0 (zero).
source.supports: ROUNDUP rounds away from zero, so a negative number moves down

derivation: -1.1 rounded away from zero to 0 digits is -2 (toward positive infinity it would be -1). ROUNDUP returns a decimal number: -2.0.
